activity_summary: You left the bakehouse while the three children were already ahead in a row. Judith Sadler put one corner of pie in a cloth, for whoever did not spend the walk arguing. You said Susanna would be the one to carry it. Sadler told you seven, and that he would not come down the lane, and he did not say twelve again.
